Salesman Daffy Duck tries to sell Elmer Fudd a range of time-saving conveniences for his home.

Tom and Jerry use various weapons to duel.

d: Tom chases Jerry on a Texas ranch where he causes inconvenience for Spike and gets tangled in cowboy events.

A ghostly gondolier wants an Italian's valuable necklace.

d: Tom helps the Wright brothers, but Jerry gets the credit.

Tom falls in love and offers Jerry as a gift for the female cat, but things turn when she lends a sympathetic ear to his plight.

t: The Tom and Jerry Comedy Show
d: Tom and Jerry set a robot maid on each other.

Ben must overcome his deathly fear of clowns and face an evil circus with a psychic vampire clown when Gwen is kidnapped.
Ben defeats a magician whose power comes from mystical charms; when Gwen finds one of his charms, she develops amazing luck in battle.
Ben changes into an alien form to ride a roller-coaster; he gets stuck as Grey Matter and finds himself captured by a sci-fi geek.

Duke Nukem destroys the ozone layer over Antarctica to feed on the dangerous UV rays.
The eco-villains steal the Planeteers' rings and leave them to rot on an island; Dr. Blight creates new rings for the eco-villains.
While enjoying a day at the beach, Tweety becomes stranded out at sea until Sylvester lends a hand to rescue him.
Wile E. Coyote uses glue, weights, rockets, and a female Road Runner costume to catch Road Runner.
Yosemite Sam tries to capture Bugs Bunny so he can be tossed to the lions.
While cooking a tin can, the Coyote spots the Road Runner, but making himself into a giant arrow doesn't catch the bird.
A man futilely struggles to make his fortune with a frog that sings and dances.
Elmer Fudd, a millionaire with a yacht and mansion, is convinced he is a rabbit; Bugs then gets convinced by his psychiatrist that he is a human; in this role reversal, Bugs goes hunting for Fudd.
Suzanne wants a real cat to play with; Sylvester runs into her yard after being chased by a bulldog, so she adopts him.
Gophers occupy the new chest in Elmer's bedroom; the animals create a system to store their nuts in the chest; Elmer, frustrated by this discovery, attempts to remove the gophers but is unsuccessful.
Mad scientist Elmer tries his best to make a "Jekyll and Hyde" potion, but his experiments always end in failure.
The hand of an unseen animator alters Bugs Bunny's world.
Bugs goes trick-or-treating as a witch on Halloween, but when he calls at Witch Hazel's house, she treats him as a threat to her claim of being the ugliest witch of all.
Bugs looks like dinner to two starving men on the Chattanooga Choo Choo.
Tom and Jerry stop by a movie theater to watch their cartoons, leading to violence in the seats.

d: Tom leaves the house.

t: The New Adventures of Tom & Jerry
d: A new colorful take on the classic characters but still with all the madcap slapstick and mayhem.

st: Down With the Ship; Willy! (or Won't He?)
d: Capt. K'nuckles wants to prove that he is a legitimate captain; Flap wants to prove that he is a real adventurer.

d: Bubbie's got a tummy ache and only Flapjack can help; Flap and K'nuckles watch Doctor Barber's office while he's gone.

Grandpa Max's past begins to come to light; a healed Vilgax decides to go after the Omnitrix prototype himself, instead of relying on mercenaries and subordinates.

Mojo the Kid robs a bank and forces the sheriff out of town.
The Planeteers gain a new ally and plan their escape from the island.
Wheeler messes up and questions his abilities as a Planeteer; he accepts a proposal to alter history to create a timeline where he doesn't join the Planeteers.
Local cat gossip says that Sylvester is no longer a great mouse catcher; to prove them wrong Sylvester takes his son mouse-catching.
Daffy Duck demands to be cast in a movie, just as the producer is looking for someone to act as Bugs Bunny's stunt double.
The Coyote relies on technology to try to capture Bugs Bunny.
Bugs washes up on the island that Yosemite Sam has been living on for 20 years.
Sylvester chases Tweety all the way out of the city and into the countryside, where all manner of obstacles await them.
Sylvester learns of the consequences of his passion for birds.
Coyote uses a bottle full of bees, a brick wall, a boulder in a catapult and a harpoon gun to try and catch the Road Runner.
Kitten raised by an old eagle grows up learning how to fly; he uses his ability to save another cat.
Bugs Bunny is confused when he awakes to find himself in a carrot patch in the middle of Tasmania, but things go from bad to worse when the Tasmanian Devil himself turns up.
Elmer Fudd is hunting Bugs Bunny and chases him into an opera where they act out their characters.
A post-war baby boom overworks the storks, so Porky and Daffy lend a hand.
Mad scientist Elmer tries his best to make a "Jekyll and Hyde" potion, but his experiments always end in failure.
A simple snowball fight escalates into an all-out snow war when snowmen come to life.

t: The New Adventures of Tom & Jerry
d: A new colorful take on the classic characters but still with all the madcap slapstick and mayhem.

t: The Tom and Jerry Comedy Show
d: Tom and Jerry become arch rivals for fame in the world of show business; Jerry, as a song and dance mouse, is in constant competition with Tom's lavish magic act until the cat's tricks backfire.
Tom's part-time job in a supermarket hits a snag when Jerry not only becomes a pest in the cheese department but when he turns the entire market into turmoil as he attempts to get Tom fired.
Tom decides to go surfing but has problems with a shark and a rather tenacious starfish.
Jerry uses radar to avoid any traps Tom has set up for him using food; Tom tries to dress up like a female mouse to trap Jerry, but he is foiled when other cats chase him.
Tom's peaceful day at the beach is disturbed by Jerry.
Jerry gets a dog to beat Tom up; he ends up in the hospital with the dog clinging to him by the teeth.
Tom wounds a duckling while hunting in the woods; Jerry doctors little Quacker.

t: The New Adventures of Tom & Jerry
d: Jerry joins a circus as the escape artist Mousini with Tom as his co-star.
Tom and Jerry battle it out with remote-controlled robots in the year 2565.
Tom has house-sitting responsibilities at a mansion while the owner is away, but Jerry won't make it very relaxing.
Scooby witnesses a robbery at a coin store by a weird zombie. The gang chases the thief to a toy factory and learns that something else is there.

st: A Frightened Hound Meets Demons Underground
d: The gang investigates the weird happenings of ancient demons who are after a talisman that will drive them back into the iron lid of an underground city where they belong.
The gang visits the hex girls at a Transylvanian castle and run into a real-life vampire.
Nigel is sick on the first snow day of the year.
Numbuh Five works to ensure her old boss will not become an agent of evil as a teen.

st: At Your Service; Chowder and Mr. Fugu
d: Mung and Chowder work for Ms. Endive to get a rare fruit; Chowder encounters someone who can eat more than he does.
Mung, Schnitzel and Chowder are stuck in a restroom while they are on vacation; Chowder tries to stay up without eating so he can reset his body clock, which causes him to become a sleep-eater.

st: A Nightmare on Aberdale Street: Balance's Revenge
d: Clarence uses a special jack-o-lantern to enter people's dreams, and learns that something is causing his friends to have nightmares.
Clarence feels the call of the wild and decides to live a life free of the modern world; with a few friends, Clarence finds a place to live in the wild, but realizes he lacks basic survival skills.
Clarence spends a day outside with his toy RC car, which he names Carla; Clarence becomes convinced Carla has a mind of her own and decides to follow her to new adventures.
